fact: Contact made at turn 1 between Cars 3 and 63.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 3 (Max Verstappen), the driver of Car 63 (George Russell), team representatives and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence and determined that there was minor contact between that cars at Turn 1. Both drivers considered this incident to be a minor racing incident and we agreed.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 3 Alleged Incident With Car 63
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
